cues: A vector dotted with itself is its length squared.
So the length of a plus or minus b, squared, expands just like algebra.
And a zero dot product means perpendicular.
text: The rules. Order does not matter. It distributes over addition. A vector dotted with itself is its length squared. So the length of a plus or minus b, squared, expands just like algebra. And a zero dot product means perpendicular.
